H4300.et: from (02904) in the sense of hammering out
H4300.def: from «02904» in the sense of hammering out; an iron bar (as forged):--bar.

H4301.def: or matmon {mat-mone'}; or matmun {mat-moon'}; from «02934»; a secret storehouse; hence, a secreted valuable (buried); generally money:--hidden riches, (hid) treasure(-s).

H4302.def: from «05193»; something planted, i.e. the place (a garden or vineyard), or the thing (a plant, figuratively or men); by implication, the act, planting:--plant(-ation, -ing).

H4303.def: or (feminine) matiammah {mat-am-maw'}; from «02938»; a delicacy:--dainty (meat), savoury meat.

H4304.def: from «02946»; a wide cloak (for a woman):--vail, wimple.

H4305.def: a primitive root; to rain:--(cause to) rain (upon).

H4307.def: or mattarah {mat-taw-raw'}; from «05201»; a jail (as a guard-house); also an aim (as being closely watched):--mark, prison.

H4310.et: an interrogative pronoun of persons, as (04100) is of things, who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things
H4310.def: an interrogative pronoun of persons, as «04100» is of things, who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix:--any (man), × he, × him, + O that! what, which, who(-m, -se, -soever), + would to God.

H4311.def: from «04325» and «01679»; water of quiet; Medeba, a place in Palestine:--Medeba.

H4312.et: from (03032) in the sense of loving
H4312.def: from «03032» in the sense of loving; affectionate; Medad, an Israelite:--Medad.

H4313.et: from (04325) and (03420) with the art. interposed
H4313.def: from «04325» and «03420» with the art. interposed; water of the yellowness; Me-haj-Jarkon, a place in Palestine:--Me-jarkon.

H4314.def: from «04325» and «02091», water of gold; Me-Zahab, an Edomite:--Mezahab.

H4316.def: a variation for «04318»; Mica, the name of two Israelites:--Micha.

H4317.et: from (04310) and (the prefix derivative from) (03588) and (0410)
H4317.def: from «04310» and (the prefix derivative from) «03588» and «0410»; who (is) like God?; Mikael, the name of an archangel and of nine Israelites:--Michael.

H4318.def: an abbrev. of «04320»; Micah, the name of seven Israelites:--Micah, Micaiah, Michah.

H4319.def: a contr. for «04321»; Mikehu, an Israelite prophet:--Micaiah (2 Chronicles 18:8).

H4320.et: from (04310) and (the prefix derivative from) (03588) and (03050)
H4320.def: from «04310» and (the prefix derivative from) «03588» and «03050»; who (is) like Jah?; Micajah, the name of two Israelites:--Micah, Michaiah. Compare «04318».

H4321.def: or Mikayhuw (Jeremiah 36:11) {me-kaw-yeh-hoo'}; abbrev. for «04322»; Mikajah, the name of three Israelites:--Micah, Micaiah, Michaiah.

H4322.def: for «04320»; Mikajah, the name of an Israelite and an Israelitess:--Michaiah.

H4323.def: from «03201»; properly, a container, i.e. a streamlet:--brook.

H4324.def: apparently the same as «04323»; revulet; Mikal, Saul's daughter:--Michal.

H4325.et: dual of a primitive noun (but used in a singular sense)
H4325.def: dual of a primitive noun (but used in a singular sense); water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen:--+ piss, wasting, water(-ing, (-course, -flood, -spring)).

H4326.def: a form for «04509»; Mijamin, the name of three Israelites:--Miamin, Mijamin.

H4327.et: from an unused root meaning to portion out
H4327.def: from an unused root meaning to portion out; a sort, i.e. species:--kind. Compare «04480».

H4328.def: properly, feminine passive participle of «03245»; something founded, i.e. a foundation:--foundation.

H4331.def: from «04185»; departure; Mesha, a place in Arabia; also an Israelite:--Mesha.

H4332.et: from (04310) and (0410) with the abbrev. insep. relatively [see (0834)] interposed
H4332.def: from «04310» and «0410» with the abbrev. insep. relatively (see «0834») interposed; who (is) what God (is)?; Mishael, the name of three Israelites:--Mishael.

H4334.def: or miyshor {mee-shore'}; from «03474»; a level, i.e. a plain (often used (with the article prefix) as a properly, name of certain districts); figuratively, concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) justice (sometimes adverbially, justly):--equity, even place, plain, right(-eously), (made) straight, uprightness.

H4336.et: of foreign origin and doubtful significance
H4336.def: (Aramaic) of foreign origin and doubtful significance; Meshak, the Babylonian name of «04333»:--Meshak.

H4338.def: a variation for «04337»; safety; Mesha, a Moabite:--Mesha.

H4339.def: from «03474»; evenness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity or concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) rectitude (only in plural with singular sense; often adverbially):--agreement, aright, that are equal, equity, (things that are) right(-eously, things), sweetly, upright(-ly, -ness).

H4340.def: from «03498»; a cord (of a tent) (compare «03499») or the string (of a bow):--cord, string.

H4341.def: sometimes makcowb {mak-obe'}; also (feminine Isaiah 53:3) makfobah {mak-o-baw'}; from «03510»; anguish or (figuratively) affliction:--grief, pain, sorrow.

H4343.def: from the same as «03522»; knoll; Macbena, a place in Palestine settled by him:--Machbenah.

H4344.def: patrial from «04343»; a Macbannite or native of Macbena:--Machbanai.

H4345.et: from (03527) in the sense of covering [compare (03531)]
H4345.def: from «03527» in the sense of covering (compare «03531»); a grate:--grate.

H4346.et: from (03527) in the sense of covering
H4346.def: from «03527» in the sense of covering; a cloth (as netted (compare «04345»)):--thick cloth.

H4347.def: or (masculine) makkeh {muk-keh'}; (plural only) from «05221»; a blow (in 2 Chronicles 2:10, of the flail); by implication, a wound; figuratively, carnage, also pestilence:--beaten, blow, plague, slaughter, smote, × sore, stripe, stroke, wound((-ed)).

H4349.def: from «03559»; properly, a fixture, i.e. a basis; generally a place, especially as an abode:--foundation, habitation, (dwelling-, settled) place.

H4350.def: or mkonah {mek-o-naw'}; feminine of «04349»; a pedestal, also a spot:--base.

H4351.et: from the same as (03564) in the sense of dipping
H4351.def: or mkorah {mek-o-raw'}; from the same as «03564» in the sense of dipping; origin (as if a mine):--birth, habitation, nativity.

H4352.def: probably from «04134»; pining; Maki, an Israelite:--Machi.

H4354.def: patronymical from «04353»; a Makirite or descend. of Makir:--of Machir.

H4355.def: a primitive root; to tumble (in ruins); figuratively, to perish:--be brought low, decay.

H4356.def: or miklah {mik-law'}; from «03607»; a pen (for flocks):--((sheep-))fold. Compare «04357».

H4357.def: from «03615»; completion (in plural concrete adverbial, wholly):--perfect. Compare «04356».

H4358.def: from «03634»; perfection (i.e. concrete adverbial, splendidly):--most gorgeously, all sorts.

H4360.def: from «03634»; something perfect, i.e. a splendid garment:--all sorts.

H4362.et: from the same as (03646) in the sense of hiding
H4362.def: from the same as «03646» in the sense of hiding; treasure (as hidden):--treasure.

H4363.def: (Ezra 2:2 or Mikmash {mik-mawsh'}; or Mikmash (Neh. 11:31) {mik-mash'}; from «03647»; hidden; Mikmas or Mikmash, a place in Palestine:--Mikmas, Mikmash.

H4364.et: from (03648) in the sense of blackening by heat
H4364.def: or mikmor {mik-more'}; from «03648» in the sense of blackening by heat; a (hunter's) net (as dark from concealment):--net.

H4365.def: or mikmoreth {mik-mo'-reth}; feminine of «04364»; a (fisher's) net:--drag, net.

H4366.et: apparently from an unused root meaning to hide
H4366.def: apparently from an unused root meaning to hide; concealment; Mikmethath, a place in Palestine:--Michmethath.

H4367.et: from (04100) and (05068) with a particle interposed
H4367.def: from «04100» and «05068» with a particle interposed; what (is) like (a) liberal (man)?; Maknadbai, an Israelite:--Machnadebai.

H4368.def: the same as «04350»; a base; Mekonah, a place in Palestine:--Mekonah.

H4370.et: from (03647) in the sense of hiding
H4370.def: from «03647» in the sense of hiding; (only in dual) drawers (from concealing the private parts):--breeches.

H4371.et: probably from an unused root meaning to enumerate
H4371.def: probably from an unused root meaning to enumerate; an assessment (as based upon a census):--tribute.

H4373.def: feminine of «04371»; an enumeration; by implication, a valuation:--number, worth.

H4374.def: from «03680»; a covering, i.e. garment; specifically, a coverlet (for a bed), an awning (from the sun); also the omentum (as covering the intestines):--clothing, to cover, that which covereth.

H4375.def: from «03717»; a fold; Makpelah, a place in Palestine:--Machpelah.

H4376.def: a primitive root; to sell, literally (as merchandise, a daughter in marriage, into slavery), or figuratively (to surrender):--X at all, sell (away, -er, self).

H4377.def: from «04376»; merchandise; also value:--pay, price, ware.

H4380.et: probably from the same as (03564) in the sense of stabbing
H4380.def: probably from the same as «03564» in the sense of stabbing; a sword:--habitation.

H4382.et: patrial from an unused name (the same as (04380)) of a place in Palestine
H4382.def: patrial from an unused name (the same as «04380») of a place in Palestine: a Mekerathite, or inhabitant of Mekerah:-- Mecherathite.

H4383.def: or mikshol {mik-shole'}; masculine from «03782»; a stumbling-block, literally or figuratively (obstacle, enticement (specifically an idol), scruple):--caused to fall, offence, × (no-)thing offered, ruin, stumbling-block.

H4384.def: feminine from «03782»; a stumbling-block, but only figuratively (fall, enticement (idol)):--ruin, stumbling-block.

H4385.def: from «03789»; a thing written, the characters, or a document (letter, copy, edict, poem):--writing.

H4387.def: from «03799»; an engraving, i.e. (techn.) a poem:--Michtam.

H4388.def: from «03806»; a mortar; by analogy, a socket (of a tooth):--hollow place, mortar.

H4389.def: the same as «04388»; dell; the Maktesh, a place in Jerusalem:--Maktesh.

H4390.def: or malae (Esth. 7:5) {maw-law'}; a primitive root, to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively):--accomplish, confirm, + consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (be, become, × draw, give in, go) full(-ly, -ly set, tale), (over-)flow, fulness, furnish, gather (selves, together), presume, replenish, satisfy, set, space, take a (hand-)full, + have wholly.

H4391.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «04390»; to fill:--fill, be full.

H4392.def: from «04390»; full (literally or figuratively) or filling (literally); also (concretely) fulness; adverbially, fully:--X she that was with child, fill(-ed, -ed with), full(-ly), multitude, as is worth.

H4393.def: rarely mlowf {mel-o'}; or mlow (Ezekiel 41:8), {mel-o'}; from «04390»; fulness (literally or figuratively):--X all along, × all that is (there-)in, fill, (X that whereof...was) full, fulness, (hand- )full, multitude.

H4394.def: from «04390»; a fulfilling (only in plural), i.e. (literally) a setting (of gems), or (technically) consecration (also concretely, a dedicatory sacrifice):--consecration, be set.

H4395.def: feminine of «04392»; something fulfilled, i.e. abundance (of produce):--(first of ripe) fruit, fulness.

H4396.def: feminine of «04394»; a filling, i.e. setting (of gems):--inclosing, setting.

H4397.et: from an unused root meaning to despatch as a deputy
H4397.def: from an unused root meaning to despatch as a deputy; a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher):--ambassador, angel, king, messenger.

H4399.def: from the same as «04397»; properly, deputyship, i.e. ministry; generally, employment (never servile) or work (abstractly or concretely); also property (as the result of labor):--business, + cattle, + industrious, occupation, (+ -pied), + officer, thing (made), use, (manner of) work((-man), -manship).
